title: SK-26-01 Bemanningstjenester helse
description: Bakgrunn Skjåk kommune er oppdragsgiver i anskaffelsen. Abakus AS gjennomfører anskaffelsen på vegne av oppdragsgiver og skal etablere en rammeavtale for bemanningstjenester innen helse og omsorg for å sikre stabil, forsvarlig og forutsigbar drift i kommunens tjenester. Behovet omfatter både planlagt fravær, som ferie og permisjoner, og uforutsett fravær, som sykefravær og ekstraordinære situasjoner. Det er behov for rask tilgang til kvalifisert helsepersonell, særlig i perioder med høy belastning som sommerferie, helger og høytider. Det er viktig at innleid personell kan settes inn med kort oppstartstid, og at leverandøren har tilstrekkelig kapasitet til å dekke både kortvarige og lengre oppdrag. Anskaffelsen gjennomføres også fordi kommunen har behov for en midlertidig løsning frem til Vågå kommune går inn i en felles anskaffelse i Nord-Gudbrandsdalen. Rammeavtalen skal dermed sikre kontinuitet i tjenestene frem til ny felles avtale er etablert. Det legges vekt på at leveransen holder høy kvalitet, og at leverandøren bidrar til seriøse og forsvarlige bemanningsløsninger i tråd med gjeldende regelverk, relevante tariffmessige forhold og krav til dokumentert kompetanse. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Leveransen omfatter i hovedsak sykepleiere, helsefagarbeidere, og vernepleiere til oppdrag av varierende omfang og varighet. Det er særlig behov for tilgjengelig personell i sommerferieperioden, ved helg og høytid, samt sykepleiere som kan stilles på kort varsel. Oppdragsgiver har behov for leverandør(er) med god tilgang på relevante vikarer og med rutiner som sikrer effektiv bestilling, tett oppfølging og rask håndtering av avvik eller behov for bytte av personell. Leverandøren må kunne levere personell med nødvendig dokumentasjon, autorisasjoner og kvalifikasjoner slik at oppdrag kan starte raskt og forsvarlig. Estimert årlig uttak under rammeavtalen er om lag kr 1 500 000 ekskl. mva. Estimatet er basert på historisk forbruk og forventet behov, og medfører ingen kjøpeplikt. Rammeavtalen planlegges å gjelde frem til 23.11.2027. Når det oppstår behov for helsevikar(er) kontaktes først leverandør A. Dersom leverandør A ikke kan levere innen tidsfrist oppgitt i bestillingen, går forespørsel til leverandør B med samme betingelser. Dersom leverandør B ikke kan levere, går forespørselen til leverandør C. Det forutsettes at leverandør A har kapasitet til å levere i de fleste tilfeller, spesielt når det gjelder planlagte uttak. Dersom leverandøren ikke har mulighet til å levere, plikter denne å oppgi dette, uten ugrunnet opphold. Oppdraget går da videre til neste leverandør i prioritert rekkefølge.

title: Germany – Fire station construction work – Planungs- und Bauleistungen sowie Leistungen der Zwischenfinanzierung für den Neubau von zwei Feuerwehrgerätehäusern und einem Gefahrenabwehrzentrum in Ritterhude
description: Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung sind Planungs- und Bauleistungen sowie Leistungen der Zwischenfinanzierung nach Maßgabe der vorliegenden Vergabeunterlagen für den Neubau von zwei Feuerwehrgerätehäusern einschließlich Gefahrenabwehrzentrum in Ritterhude. Die Gemeinde Ritterhude im Landkreis Osterholz-Scharmbeck in Niedersachsen ist gemäß §1 und §2 des Niedersächsischen Brandschutzgesetzes (NBrand-SchG) verpflichtet, eine den örtlichen Verhältnissen entsprechende leistungsfähige Feuerwehr vorzuhalten. Die bestehende Feuerwehrgerätehäuser entsprechen aufgrund baulicher, funktionaler und arbeitsschutzrechtlicher Mängel nicht mehr den heutigen Anforderungen. Zur Sicherstellung einer zukunftsfähigen Feuerwehrinfrastruktur ist der Neubau von zwei Feuerwehrgerätehäusern an den Standorten Ihlpohl-Platjenwerbe und Stendorf zwingend erforderlich. Die Gemeinde Ritterhude ist zudem verpflichtet, eine leistungsfähige Struktur zur Gefahrenabwehr sowie zum Zivil- und Bevölkerungsschutz vorzuhalten. Die zunehmenden Anforderungen durch Extremwetterereignisse, großflächige Scha-denslagen und Krisenszenarien machen eine moderne, belastbare und zentral organisierte Infrastruktur erforderlich. Derzeit hält die Gemeinde diese nicht vor. Daher soll die Errichtung eines Infrastrukturstandortes für die Bereiche Gefahrenabwehr, Zivil- und Bevölkerungsschutz gleichzeitig mit den beiden Feuerwehrgerätehäusern realisiert werden. Die vollständige Inbetriebnahme der Feuerwehrgerätehäuser sowie des Gefahrenabwehrzentrums ist zum November 2029 vorgesehen, der Standort FGH Stendorf soll früher in Betrieb gehen. Die dafür vorgesehenen Grundstücke an den Standorten IhlpohlPlatjenwerbe und Stendorf befinden sich bereits im Eigentum der Gemeinde Ritterhude. Es ist das Ziel der Gemeinde Ritterhude, das Projekt in Bezug auf die Lebenszykluskosten wirtschaftlich zu optimieren und unter maximaler Kosten- und Termintreue zu einem Pauschalfestpreis umzusetzen. Der Handlungsbedarf erfordert ei-ne zeitnahe Umsetzung der Maßnahme, für die in konventioneller Realisierung seitens der Bauverwaltung keine ausreichenden Kapazitäten bereitgestellt werden können. Unter dieser Maßgabe soll das Projekt in alternativer Beschaffungsvariante in einem Totalunternehmermodell umgesetzt werden. Die TU-Gesamtmaßnahme umfasst die Planung, den Bau, die Bauzwischenfinanzierung und Wartungsleistungen für beide Standorte. Die Endfinanzierung erfolgt über die Gemeinde Ritterhude, auch der spätere Gebäudebetrieb. Die Gewährleis-tungsfrist gem. Vertrag wird bei 5 Jahren für alle Leistungen liegen, für die Dichtheit von Dach bei 10 Jahren. Weitere Details zur Ausschreibung sind den Vergabeunterlagen zu entnehmen.

title: Eselriet School Campus Extension, BKP 421 Landscaping Works
description:
The Eselriet school complex is located on the southwestern edge of the settlement area of Effretikon, at the transition to the surrounding landscape, flanked by forests and agricultural land. The building ensemble, dating from 1974, is characterized by a coherent architectural language typical of its time. Oriented towards the south, it integrates into its natural surroundings with a clearly defined outline. Functionally distinct building wings are arranged around a central schoolyard, forming a cohesive overall composition.

The project involves the extension of the school complex through the construction of a compact new building directly attached to the existing sports hall. The existing and new structures are combined to form a coherent and integrated facility. A wide and clearly organized entrance area will be created from Sportplatzstrasse, improving accessibility and orientation.

The new building accommodates the extensive space requirements for school operations, day-care services, and local sports clubs under a single roof. Its access and vertical circulation system allows both shared use and independent operation by the different user groups. Two separate entrances open up the building and help to separate the various functions. A central staircase and elevator provide access to all floors and connect all parts of the building.

The second and third floors follow a consistent layout concept. On the second floor, four classrooms and intermediate group rooms form an educational cluster around a central common area and cloakroom zone. The third floor accommodates therapy and speech therapy rooms, as well as facilities for the support and learning centre.

The basement houses a multipurpose room with direct access to the sports hall. A staircase and elevator connect this space with the kitchen and communal facilities on the ground floor.

title: Kirjallisuuden hankinta
description: Pirkanmaan kirjastojen yhteistoimintasopimukseen sitoutuneiden kuntien yleiset kirjastot (PIKI-kirjastot) ovat tilanteessa, joissa painetun kirjallisuuden hankintasopimukset ovat päättymässä, ja uusi kilpailutus on ajankohtainen. Kuntien yhteinen tahtotila on kilpailuttaa painetun kirjallisuuden hankinta PIKI-kirjastojen yhteisenä hankintarenkaana. Tampereen kaupunki valmistelee hankintaa PIKI-kirjastojen yhteistoiminta-sopimuksen mukaisesti. Kyseessä on hankintalain 26 § 1 mom. 2-kohdassa säädetyn EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä tavarahankinta, joka toteutetaan julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeussopimuksista annetun lain (1397/2016) 32 §:n mukaisena avoimena menettelynä. Kyseessä on usean toimittajan puitejärjestely. Hankinta on jaettu suomenkielisen ja muunkielisen kirjallisuuden osa-alueisiin. Kuhunkin osa-alueeseen valitaan viisi (5) toimittajaa tarjousten vertailussa muodostuvan etusijajärjestyksen mukaisesti. Mikäli osa-alueella on vähemmän kuin viisi (5) soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävää tarjoajaa tai hyväksyttävää tarjousta, puitejärjestelyyn valitaan kaikki kyseisen osa-alueen soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttäneet tarjoajat, jotka ovat jättäneet tarjouspyynnön mukaisen hyväksyttävän tarjouksen. . Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden perusteet (arviointikriteerit) on esitetty tässä tarjouspyynnössä liitteessä Vertailukriteerit. Sopimuskaudella hankinta tapahtuu pääosin hankintaportaalin kautta; portaali vertailee kunkin yksittäisen hankinnan hintoja ja ohjaa tilauksen sille toimittajalle, joka tarjoaa sen edullisimpaan hintaan., Suomenkielinen kirjallisuus Suomenkielisessä kirjallisuuden osa-alueessa tarjonnan tulee yleisen kirjallisuuden lisäksi sisältää laaja valikoima julkisten organisaatioiden, erilaisten yritysten ja yhdistysten ja muiden pien- ja omakustantajien tuotantoa. Lisäksi tulee tarjota kotimaisia nuotteja ja karttoja., Muunkielinen kirjallisuus Muunkielinen kirjallisuus on muuta kuin suomenkielistä ja Suomessa kustannettua kirjallisuutta. Muunkielisessä kirjallisuudessa tarjonnan tulee olla riittävän laaja ja monipuolinen. Tilaajalla on halutessaan oikeus hankkia ulkomaisia nuotteja ja karttoja sopimuksen kautta.,

title: Ilmanpuhdistuslaitteiden vuokraus ja hankinta
description: Vantaan kaupunki pyytää tarjouksia ilmanpuhdistimien vuokraamisesta ja hankinnasta. Hankinnan kohteena ovat vuokrattavat ja ostettavat sisäilmanpuhdistuslaitteet julkisiin tiloihin, kuten koulu- ja päiväkotitiloihin, toimistoihin, arkistoihin, auditorioihin jne. Tilaajat hankkivat pääosin vuokrattavia laitteita, ja vähäisissä määrin laitteita tullaan ostamaan omaksi. Ilmanpuhdistimilla haetaan väliaikaista ratkaisua sisäilmaongelmien hallintaan käyttöä turvaavana toimenpiteenä. Ilmanpuhdistimien tulee olla tarkoitettu tähän käyttötarkoitukseen. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 2 Palvelukuvaus. Kilpailutus suoritetaan avoimella menettelyllä, jonka perusteella jokaiseen osa-alueeseen puitetoimittajiksi valitaan kolme (3) vertailussa eniten pisteitä saanutta tarjoajaa etusijajärjestyksessä. Hankinta kilpailutetaan yhteishankintana niin, että Vantaan kaupunki julkaisee tarjouspyynnön. Kilpailutuksen perusteella tehdään samansisältöiset, sopimusluonnoksen (liite 1) mukaiset sopimukset Vantaan kaupungille, Kauniaisten kaupungille ja Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueelle. Hankintayksiköt tekevät myös oman päätöksensä. Vantaan kaupungille tehtävien sopimusten perusteella hankintoja voivat tehdä Vantaan kaupungin kaikki toimialat sekä Vantaan Tilapalvelut Vantti Oy, VTK Kiinteistöt Oy- konserni, VAV Yhtymä Oy, VAV Asunnot Oy, VAV Palvelukodit Oy, VAV Hoiva-asunnot Oy, Hakopolun Liikekiinteistö Oy, Kiinteistö Oy Hakucenter, Kiinteistö Oy Vantaan Maakotkantie 10, Pallastunturintien Liikekiinteistö Oy ja Asunto Oy Vantaan Katriinanrinne. Sopimustoimittaja voi tarjota samoin ehdoin tuotteitaan ja palvelujaan Vantaan kaupungin seuraaville konsernitoimijoille: Vivamus Kiinteistöt Oy ja Kiinteistö Oy Vantaan Sote-tilat. Sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta, jonka jälkeen sopimusta voidaan jatkaa kahdella (2) yhden (1) vuoden optiolla (1+1). Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa ilmoitettuihin euromääräisiin arvoihin tai tiettyihin arvioituihin hankintamääriin sopimuskaudella., Osa-alue 1: Puhtaanilmantuotto 160 m3/h Ilmanpuhdistuslaitteiden vuokraus ja hankinta toimistotiloihin., Osa-alue 2: Puhtaanilmantuotto 400 m3/h Ilmanpuhdistinten vuokraus ja hankinta., Osa-alue 3: Puhtaanilmantuotto 800 m3/h Ilmanpuhdistinten vuokraus ja hankinta isoihin tiloihin.,

title: Access Control and Intrusion Detection Services
description: The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) requires the provision of parts and labour (technical support, programming, installation, service, and maintenance) on an “as and when requested” basis for its Integrated Security System (ISS) at CRA locations across Canada. The CRA is considering the conversion of up to 51 sites currently using a combination of Digital Security Controls (DSC) Intrusion Detection Systems and Kantech Access Control systems to a unified Kantech Intrusion/Access Control platform. The site counts identified below represent the CRA’s current intended conversion plans for planning and estimation purposes only and do not constitute a commitment to convert any specific number of sites. The CRA requires the goods and services referenced above in the following regions: 1. National Capital Region (NCR) – up to 11 sites identified for potential conversion; 2. Ontario – up to 13 sites identified for potential conversion; 3. Quebec – up to 1 site identified for potential conversion; 4. Atlantic – up to 4 sites identified for potential conversion; and 5. Western – up to 22 sites identified for potential conversion. Bidders may submit a bid for one (1) or more Regions identified in this RFP. Only one (1) bid submission is required, regardless of the number of Regions for which the Bidder is submitting a bid. The Bidder's submission must clearly identify each Region for which it is proposing to provide the required goods and services. For each Region bid, the Bidder must provide all information required by this RFP, including any Region-specific technical information, resource information, and pricing, in the format prescribed in the bid solicitation documents. Requirement, project experience, certification, corporate qualification, or other bid components that are not Region-specific need only be submitted once and will be evaluated for all Regions included in the Bidder's submission. Bids for Multiple Regions: Requirements identified as Region-specific will be evaluated only for the applicable Region. Requirements that are not Region-specific will be evaluated once and will apply to all Regions included in the Bidder's submission. The CRA will evaluate each Region independently. Where a Bidder fails to meet a Region-specific requirement, the CRA may declare the bid non-responsive for that Region only. For greater certainty, a determination that a bid is non-responsive for one (1) Region will not, in itself, render the Bidder's submission non-responsive for any other Region for which a bid as been submitted, provided all applicable requirements for those Regions are met. The CRA intends to award up to five (5) contracts to fulfill this requirement. A Bidder may be awarded a contract for one (1) Region, multiple Regions, or all five (5) Regions. The period of the resulting contract(s) will be for three (3) firm years. The contract(s) will include four (4) irrevocable one-year options to extend the period of the contract(s). The contract(s) will also include provisions allowing the CRA to add, remove or modify products and sites. A bid must comply with the requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory evaluation criteria to be declared responsive. For each Region, the responsive bid with the highest combined rating of technical merit and price will be recommended for award of a contract. Each Region will be evaluated separately. Where the same Bidder is ranked first for multiple Regions, the CRA will award a single contract covering the Regions for which that Bidder is the highest-ranked responsive bidder. The Bid Compliance and Remedy Process (BCRP) defined in Part 4.2 will apply. Proposal documents and supporting information must be submitted in either English or French. Questions must be directed in writing to the contracting authority via email: Timothy.Berg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids must be submitted by using the Connect service provided by the Canada Post Corporation. When responding, the proposal MUST be delivered to: Canada Revenue Agency Bid Receiving Unit BRUg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids will not be accepted if emailed directly to this email address. This email address must be used to request that CRA open a Connect conversation, as detailed in Standard Instructions 2003. Bidders must not use their own licensing agreement for Connect to initiate a Connect conversation with CRA. The CRA reserves the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. There are security requirements associated with this requirement. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. The Federal Contractors Program (FCP) for employment equity applies to this procurement. This bid solicitation 1000536720/B cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number 1000536720/A dated 2026-03-27 with a closing of 2026-05-19 02:00 PM EDT. This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers and to Suppliers of an applicable trading partner. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. The CRA will include the following minimum work guarantees (all applicable taxes included) over the entire period of the resulting contract(s), which includes any exercised option periods, including any extension period thereof: 1. National Capital Region (NCR) – $100,000 CAD; 2. Ontario – $100,000 CAD; 3. Quebec – $50,000 CAD; 4. Atlantic – $50,000 CAD; and 5. Western – $100,000 CAD.

title: Purchase of One (1) Liquid Chromatography System
description: Tendering Procedures: Invitation to tenders following instructions on the Supply Arrangement Competitive Procurement Strategy: Contract against the SA will be awarded to the supplier responding to all mandatory technical criteria and with the lowest price. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: No Nature of Requirements: Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, SA E60PV-19EQUI for the purchase of : One (1) Liquid Chromatography System Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, Kentville Research and Development Centre THIS REQUEST IS RESERVED FOR HOLDERS OF SUPPLY ARRANGEMENT # E60PV-19EQUI ONLY, FOR THE PURCHASE OF LABORATORY AND SCIENTIFIC EQUIPMENT, PARTS AND ACCESSORIES, SERVICES AND SUPPLIES. Only Suppliers currently pre-qualified on Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI have been invited to bid. As a requirement of the Supply Arrangement, this notice is published on Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) for a period of 40 calendar days. The closing date published on this notice identifies how long the notice will be published. For the closing date of any solicitation under the supply arrangement, invited suppliers should refer to the solicitation documents. Suppliers that do not have a Supply Arrangement for the supply of Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies with Public Works and Government Services Canada, cannot submit a bid. Any bids received from suppliers not pre-qualified on the Supply Arrangement will not be evaluated. Suppliers may qualify under Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies, at any time. Interested suppliers should download solicitation document E60PV-19EQUI/D from CanadaBuys (SAP Ariba) and submit a response as per the requirements of the Request for Supply Arrangement. The responsive bidder already holding a Supply arrangement for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies from Public Works and Government Services Canada who meets the mandatory technical criteria with the lowest aggregate price will be recommended for contract award. The mandatory technical criteria are: Liquid Chromatography (LC) System a. The LC system must be supplied with an LC solution suitable for proteomics, such as a nano-flow LC system for peptide sample preparation and separation, designed for seamless coupling to the MS. The system must operate at flow rates ranging from at least 200 nL/min to 100 µL/min and must not require a flow splitter. b. The LC system must have the maximum operating pressure at least to 15,000 psi. c. The LC system must be capable of operating within a pH range of 2–10. d. The LC system must support two-dimensional (2D) LC analysis, including an auxiliary solvent and trap valve manager, a column-trapping pump, nano-Lock spray capability, primary check valves, column compartment, and switching valves configured for 2D operation. All primary wetted materials must be included. e. The LC system must support unattended operation, with full diagnostic data display for up to 96 hours through the control software. f. The LC system must include solvent storage, with a solvent tray capable of accommodating up to three (3) eluents. g. The LC system must include a micro-binary solvent delivery system, supporting solvents A1 or A2 and B1 or B2, and must provide solvent conditioning, gradient formation, primary check valves, compressibility compensation, and automatic priming. Pump compositional precision must be < 0.25% RSD based on repeated injections. The system must be equipped with an integrated, programmable active wash system to flush the rear of the high-pressure seals. h. The LC system must include a sample handling system with an injection volume range from 0.1 µL to 100 µL, with 5 µL standard injection, supporting 1, 2, 5, 20, 50, and 100 µL injection options, and unlimited volume for trapping. The system must have full-loop and partial-loop injection modes. The autosampler must accommodate 96- or 48-position sample plates with 2.0 mL vials and include a temperature-controlled autosampler (4.0–40.0 °C) with high temperature accuracy and stability. The system must have a column chamber (temperature controlled). i. All equipment must be certified or approved for use in accordance with the Canadian Electrical Code; j. The LC system must be CSA certified upon delivery.

title: Joinery Contractors Framework
description: NHS Lanarkshire Health Board (“the Board”) invites suitably qualified and experienced contractors to tender for appointment to the NHSL329-26 Joinery Contractors Framework. The framework will support the Property & Support Services Division in delivering planned, reactive, routine and emergency joinery works across NHS Lanarkshire’s healthcare estate. The framework will comprise three lots: Lot 1: University Hospital Monklands, works below GBP 5,000 - Lot 1 covers planned, routine, reactive and emergency joinery works valued below GBP 5,000 at University Hospital Monklands. One contractor will be appointed and must provide a responsive service, including 24-hour, 365-day emergency cover, in accordance with the specified priority response times. Lot 2: Community Sites, works below GBP 5,000 - Lot 2 covers planned, routine, reactive and emergency joinery works valued below GBP 5,000 across the NHS Lanarkshire community sites listed in Appendix A of the Specification. One contractor will be appointed and must provide a responsive service, including 24-hour, 365-day emergency cover and travel between sites where required. Lot 3: Small Works valued between GBP 5,000 and GBP 50,000 - Lot 3 covers planned joinery works valued over GBP 5,000 and up to GBP 50,000. Between three and five contractors may be appointed, comprising Primary and Reserve Contractors. Requirements will normally be awarded through quotation or mini-competition, with the applicable award criteria and quality-to-price weighting confirmed for each requirement. The framework will operate for an initial period of 24 months, with the option to extend for a further two 12-month periods. Contractors must provide a safe, reliable and responsive service that supports clinical operations.

title: Protein ENGineering (PENG)
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) is soliciting innovative proposals for the development of a multifunctional, target-agnostic platform for precise, programmable editing of endogenous proteins. The goal of the Protein ENGineering (PENG) program is to transition proteome engineering from a collection of isolated, bespoke tools into a universal, software-defined discipline. The PENG program will establish a comprehensive, integrated platform composed of modular targeting, generalizable effector chemistries, and multiplexed control systems. Rather than developing isolated, target-specific tools, performers will integrate novel splicing, ligation, and co-translational techniques to directly recognize, modify, and rewrite endogenous proteins within complex biological architectures. Performers may explore multiple technical paths, progressively advancing their approaches from foundational validation to robust demonstrations of efficacy. Ultimately, this integrated platform will be validated in high-fidelity cellular models (e.g., organoids), to provide an integrated proof-of-concept at the tissue level.

title: Z2DA--589A7-23-306 Renovate Bldg. 5 & 5B for Mental Health FY27 NRM
description: Contractor shall perform construction and renovation of the existing space in Building 5 &/or 5B at the Robert J. Dole VA Medical Center campus. This project will prepare approximately 1,100 SF of existing space in building 5 and/or 5B for use as a same day access mental health clinic in adherence to VHA directive 1231(2) & VHA Handbook 1160.1. This project shall be executed in a manner, following the sequence defined in the design narrative, to maintain continuous operations of adjacent VA clinical functions and medical center functionality throughout construction. All construction work shall be performed in full compliance with the complete set of bidding documents, including all contract drawings, specifications, and design narratives associated with this solicitation necessary to convert the existing space into four exam rooms, a combined waiting/reception area, a relocated police office, and associated support spaces. The general contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to execute the required scope of work. Construction will consist of, but is not limited to, the following: � Selective demolition of existing interior partitions, ceilings, finishes, and elements required for new clinic layout. � Installation of new interior finishes including flooring, wall finishes, ceilings, trim, and casework. � Implementation of therapeutic design features, including calm color schemes, anchored artwork, secure hardware, and achieving a minimum STC-45 acoustic rating for exam room partitions. � Installation of new wall-mounted lavatories in each exam room. Routing new domestic hot and cold water from adjacent restrooms and trenching new water lines across the corridor to existing tin-in points. � Rebalancing and modifying HVAC systems; reusing the existing rooftop AHU serving the building; relocating or adding diffusers/grilles; installing ligature-resistant diffusers in exam rooms � Providing new electrical receptacles, data outlets, and circuits to support clinical functions � Installing LED lighting including secured, ligature-resistant fixtures in exam rooms; relocating or supplementing lighting in general spaces; adding occupancy sensors. � Removal of existing sprinklers, providing temporary upright sprinkler coverage during construction, and installing new sprinklers to meet NFPA 13 standards Statement of Work for Project 589A7-23-306, Renovate 5 & 5B for Mental Health July 08, 2026 2 � Site preparation for installation of Government?furnished equipment, including structural supports, utility connections, and required interfaces. � Hazardous materials abatement, including asbestos remediation in areas identified during construction; asbestos?containing materials are expected in some work areas and must be removed or handled per applicable VA, EPA, OSHA, and state/local regulations. � All other items as described in the contract documents. This construction work is located in an occupied, operational clinical facility and must be performed in a manner that allows medical care services to continue uninterrupted throughout construction, This requires carefully phased construction, strict adherence to ICRA, infection control, noise/vibration limits, and daily coordination with the VA COR and end users. Construction may also include the abatement of any asbestos as identified on the provided drawings. The construction of this project will take place in a very busy occupied building and is to be completed to allow medical care functions to be maintained uninterrupted throughout construction � necessitating carefully phased construction and coordination with VA COR/users, including strict adherence to ICRA requirements.

title: AN/BYG-1 Applications
description: Description SOLICITATION ANNOUNCEMENT: AN/BYG-1 APPLICATIONS The Department of the Navy, Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), on behalf of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Undersea (PAE Undersea) and the Director, Submarine Programs (DSP), is releasing the formal solicitation for the AN/BYG-1 Applications requirement from the Submarine Combat and Weapons Control Program Office (PMS 425). This notice follows the previously published Draft Request for Proposal (RFP) and Industry Day event. The Government has reviewed the feedback received during and after the Industry Day and has revised the requirements accordingly for this final solicitation. SCOPE OF THE REQUIREMENT (GENERAL OVERVIEW) AN/BYG-1 is the U.S. Navy�s Submarine Combat Control System. The AN/BYG-1 provides tools for the analysis of surface, sub-surface, and airborne contacts operating in the vicinity of own-ship and within the mission theater. This analysis supports command and decision-making, payload and attack control functions, determination of ballistic data for legacy torpedoes, and initiation of firing sequence for all payload types in support of submarine mission areas. The scope of this solicitation encompasses the development, testing, integration, delivery, logistics, and full-lifecycle sustainment of compiled AN/BYG-1 software baselines. This includes current, future, and legacy AN/BYG-1 applications as part of a modernized capability delivery framework. Key objectives and technical efforts under this contract include: Deliver AN/BYG-1 capabilities and baselines in alignment with Submarine Tactical Requirements Group priorities Decouple AN/BYG-1 applications from hardware and software dependencies Implement microcontainer/microservices AN/BYG-1 architecture Transform AN/BYG-1 development and test environments by increasing virtualization and establishing a common, shared infrastructure Develop and integrate tactical decision aids that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies Assist with the design, development, and integration of combat control system elements to support international cooperative agreements and joint programs. ACCESS TO SOLICITATION DOCUMENTS AND CLASSIFIED DATA The AN/BYG-1 Applications solicitation, Statement of Work (SOW), and associated unclassified attachments are designated as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and will not be posted directly to SAM.gov. These documents will be made available exclusively via the secure Electronic Technical Information Center (E-TIC) portal hosted by the Advanced Interactive Management Technology Center (AIMTC). Additionally, portions of the Government Furnished Information, specifically, the classified software source code provided to support proposal development are classified at the SECRET level and will be transmitted physically. Documents made available during this procurement may contain classified data and/or technical data whose export is restricted by the Arms Export Control Act. Foreign participation shall be limited by applicable legal authorities, regulations, and other security classification requirements as specified in the DD Form 254. title: USACE - Industry Day 2026
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Middle East District, will host an in-person and virtual Industry Day on 22 October 2026. Check-in on the day of the event will begin at 0730. Tentative agenda will include a Contracting and Programs overview along with a focused session on the upcoming Qatar Development of Al Udeid (QDA) program and an upcoming Space Campus project that is anticipated to be awarded via a new delivery method called Integrated Design and Construction (IDaC). There will be an opportunity for breakout sessions and a question & answer (Q&A) session with Contracting, Construction, Engineering, and Programs and Project Management. The location will be the DoubleTree by Hilton, Blue Ridge Shadows, 111 Hospitality Drive, Front Royal, VA 22630. The purpose of Industry Day is for our architect-engineer and general contractor partners to have a glimpse of the current and upcoming program opportunities in the CENTCOM Area of Responsibility (AOR) to allow both USACE and our contractor community to be better prepared for the work ahead. There will be an opportunity to openly discuss any questions, comments, concerns, and best practices contractors have about working in the CENTCOM AOR during the Q&A session. The Middle East District will solicit questions from industry in advance of the event. Please submit any questions by 1600 Eastern Daylight Time, 16 October 2025 to the attention of Jeanette Farrell at Jeanette.M.Farrell@usace.army.mil, with the Subject Line: Industry Day Oct 2026. Questions will be evaluated, and responses provided during the Q&A portion of the event. All attendees are required to register online to provide their company name and attendee names with titles by 19 October 2026. Please register using the following hyperlink: https://events.dod.teams.microsoft.us/event/e963de64-91e6-4c99-9f20-cf582117491c@fc4d76ba-f17c-4c50-b9a7-8f3163d27582?source=copyLinkLegacyShareLinkDialog When entering the meeting via MS Teams, please enter as a guest utilizing the email provided during registration. We are currently not limiting in-person attendance at the event; however, this may change if an overwhelming number of companies intend to send representatives. A questionnaire is included for the submittal with RSVP. There is no cost to attend this event. Presentation slides will be provided prior to the event. For questions regarding this event, please feel free to contact Jeanette Farrell at the email address shown above.

title: USACE - Industry Day 2026
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Middle East District, will host an in-person and virtual Industry Day on 22 October 2026. Check-in on the day of the event will begin at 0730. Tentative agenda will include a Contracting and Programs overview and a focused session on the Qatar Development Area Space Campus. There will be an opportunity for breakout sessions and a question & answer (Q&A) session with Contracting, Construction, Engineering, and Programs and Project Management. The location will be the DoubleTree by Hilton, Blue Ridge Shadows, 111 Hospitality Drive, Front Royal, VA 22630. The purpose of Industry Day is for our architect-engineer and general contractor partners to have a glimpse of the current and upcoming program opportunities in the CENTCOM Area of Responsibility (AOR) to allow both USACE and our contractor community to be better prepared for the work ahead. There will be an opportunity to openly discuss any questions, comments, concerns, and best practices contractors have about working in the CENTCOM AOR during the Q&A session. The Middle East District will solicit questions from industry in advance of the event. Please submit any questions by 1600 Eastern Daylight Time, 16 October 2025 to the attention of Jeanette Farrell at Jeanette.M.Farrell@usace.army.mil, with the Subject Line: Industry Day Oct 2026. Questions will be evaluated, and responses provided during the Q&A portion of the event. All attendees are required to register online to provide their company name and attendee names with titles by 19 October 2026. Please register using the following hyperlink: https://events.dod.teams.microsoft.us/event/e963de64-91e6-4c99-9f20-cf582117491c@fc4d76ba-f17c-4c50-b9a7-8f3163d27582?source=copyLinkLegacyShareLinkDialog When entering the meeting via MS Teams, please enter as a guest utilizing the email provided during registration. We are currently not limiting in-person attendance at the event; however, this may change if an overwhelming number of companies intend to send representatives. A questionnaire is included for the submittal with RSVP. There is no cost to attend this event. Presentation slides will be provided prior to the event. For questions regarding this event, please feel free to contact Jeanette Farrell at the email address shown above.

title: AN/BYG-1 Applications
description: Description NOTE: On 8 August 2026, Solicitation Amendment 001 was published in the E-TIC portal, including a revised solicitation, a revised Section L, and a Question & Answer set Batch 1. SOLICITATION ANNOUNCEMENT: AN/BYG-1 APPLICATIONS The Department of the Navy, Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), on behalf of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Undersea (PAE Undersea) and the Director, Submarine Programs (DSP), is releasing the formal solicitation for the AN/BYG-1 Applications requirement from the Submarine Combat and Weapons Control Program Office (PMS 425). This notice follows the previously published Draft Request for Proposal (RFP) and Industry Day event. The Government has reviewed the feedback received during and after the Industry Day and has revised the requirements accordingly for this final solicitation. SCOPE OF THE REQUIREMENT (GENERAL OVERVIEW) AN/BYG-1 is the U.S. Navy�s Submarine Combat Control System. The AN/BYG-1 provides tools for the analysis of surface, sub-surface, and airborne contacts operating in the vicinity of own-ship and within the mission theater. This analysis supports command and decision-making, payload and attack control functions, determination of ballistic data for legacy torpedoes, and initiation of firing sequence for all payload types in support of submarine mission areas. The scope of this solicitation encompasses the development, testing, integration, delivery, logistics, and full-lifecycle sustainment of compiled AN/BYG-1 software baselines. This includes current, future, and legacy AN/BYG-1 applications as part of a modernized capability delivery framework. Key objectives and technical efforts under this contract include: Deliver AN/BYG-1 capabilities and baselines in alignment with Submarine Tactical Requirements Group priorities Decouple AN/BYG-1 applications from hardware and software dependencies Implement microcontainer/microservices AN/BYG-1 architecture Transform AN/BYG-1 development and test environments by increasing virtualization and establishing a common, shared infrastructure Develop and integrate tactical decision aids that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies Assist with the design, development, and integration of combat control system elements to support international cooperative agreements and joint programs. ACCESS TO SOLICITATION DOCUMENTS AND CLASSIFIED DATA The AN/BYG-1 Applications solicitation, Statement of Work (SOW), and associated unclassified attachments are designated as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and will not be posted directly to SAM.gov. These documents will be made available exclusively via the secure Electronic Technical Information Center (E-TIC) portal hosted by the Advanced Interactive Management Technology Center (AIMTC). Additionally, portions of the Government Furnished Information, specifically, the classified software source code provided to support proposal development are classified at the SECRET level and will be transmitted physically. Documents made available during this procurement may contain classified data and/or technical data whose export is restricted by the Arms Export Control Act. Foreign participation shall be limited by applicable legal authorities, regulations, and other security classification requirements as specified in the DD Form 254. Consolidated Access Request Instructions Prospective Offerors must submit a single, consolidated access request email to the Points of Contact listed below to obtain E-TIC portal access and the classified GFI software package. Email Attachments Required: DD Form 254: A completed copy of the DD Form 254. Block 6 must verify that the requesting company possesses a Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) issued SECRET facility clearance (FCL) and SECRET safeguarding capability. CRITICAL SECURITY NOTE FOR AWARD ELIGIBILITY: While a SECRET FCL is sufficient for proposal preparation and GFI access, the Offeror must ultimately possess a fully adjudicated TOP SECRET facility clearance and TOP SECRET safeguarding capability, issued by the U.S. Government, no later than contract award. The Government will not sponsor facility clearance upgrades or personnel clearance upgrades for the purpose of proposal submission or contract award eligibility. DD Form 2345: A current, approved copy of the company�s DD Form 2345 (Military Critical Technical Data Agreement). Executed Terms of Use Agreement (TOUA): A signed copy of the TOUA, executed by the Offeror's Facility Security Officer (FSO) or authorized corporate representative. Email Body Requirements: Subject Line: Format as N00024-26-R-6222 Access Request - [Insert Company Name]. Company Info: Provide the Company Name and active CAGE Code. E-TIC Representative: Provide the full name, official company email address, and phone number of the designated individual who will serve as the E-TIC account holder. Classified Media Request (Yes/No): State explicitly whether your company is requesting delivery of the classified software source code. Classified Mailing Info (Required only if requesting Classified Media): Provide the name and contact information of the company's FSO, along with the verified Classified Mailing Address of your facility as registered in the National Industrial Security System (NISS). If your company is NOT requesting the classified source code, please state "Not Applicable" or "N/A" for these fields. E-TIC Portal Registration (Unclassified/CUI Documents) Once the Government approves the consolidated request, the designated E-TIC representative must complete their account setup on the AIMTC portal. Access requires a DoD Common Access Card (CAC) or an approved DoD External Certification Authority (ECA) Certificate, along with an active Joint Certification Program (JCP) registration number. For New AIMTC Account Requests: Visit https://aimtc.nuwc.navy.mil and complete the AIMTC Account Request Form. For Existing AIMTC Account Holders: Log into https://aimtc.nuwc.navy.mil, click �My Profile�, and update your fields exactly as follows: Name: First name, middle initial, last name. Foreign National: Select "Yes" or "No". Email Address: Official company email only (no Gmail, Yahoo, etc.). Branch or Code: PMS425 Phone Number: Requestor's direct phone number. Please note that you will not be able to access the PMS425 AN/BYG-1 Applications until your account request is approved by the Approval Official and processed. Please allow for processing. If E-TIC access has not been granted within five (5) business days of your initial email package submission, please contact the Points of Contact listed below for status. The proposal due date will not be extended due to late or incomplete access requests. Over the course of the procurement, the Government may provide E-TIC updates or additional materials to the same designated company representative. title: Netherlands – Recruitment services – Europese aanbesteding inhuurbrokerdienstverlening
description: Kennisnet maakt voor de uitvoering van haar werkzaamheden gebruik van externe professionals, waaronder ICT-specialisten, adviseurs, projectmanagers en overige ondersteunende functies. De huidige raamovereenkomst voor brokerdienstverlening eindigt op 1 januari 2027. Om de continuïteit van de externe personeelsvoorziening te waarborgen, wordt een nieuwe Europese aanbesteding uitgevoerd voor het contracteren van drie inhuurbrokerdienstverleners. Kennisnet zoekt brokerdienstverleners die in staat zijn hoogwaardige dienstverlening te leveren op het gebied van werving en selectie, contractering, administratieve afhandeling, facturatie, compliance en advies rondom externe inhuur. Daarbij hecht Kennisnet grote waarde aan transparantie in tarieven en ketens, naleving van wet- en regelgeving en actieve ondersteuning bij risico's rondom arbeidsrelaties. De opdracht omvat ten minste de volgende werkzaamheden: Het werven, selecteren en aanbieden van geschikte externe professionals; Het verzorgen van de contractuele, administratieve en financiële afhandeling van externe inhuur; Het beheersen van risico's op het gebied van arbeidsrelaties, fiscaliteit, ketenaansprakelijkheid en schijnzelfstandigheid; Het bieden van transparantie in tariefopbouw, ketensamenstelling en marges; Het adviseren van Kennisnet over arbeidsmarktontwikkelingen, wet- en regelgeving, tarieven en passende contractvormen. De brokerdienstverlener dient gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst ten minste de volgende dienstverlening te leveren: Het uitvoeren van werving- en selectiewerkzaamheden voor externe professionals; Het contracteren en administratief afhandelen van door Kennisnet geselecteerde kandidaten; Het faciliteren van minicompetities en het tijdig aanbieden van passende kandidaten; Het verzorgen van facturatie en financiële afwikkeling van ingezette professionals; Het verstrekken van managementinformatie en periodieke rapportages; Het ondersteunen van Kennisnet bij de naleving van de Wet DBA, Wtta en overige relevante wet- en regelgeving; Het begeleiden van de overgang van bestaande inhuur en het ondersteunen bij een eventuele exit naar een opvolgend broker. Naast de operationele dienstverlening vervult de brokerdienstverlener gedurende de gehele looptijd van de raamovereenkomst een actieve adviesrol. Van de broker wordt verwacht dat deze gevraagd en ongevraagd adviseert over ontwikkelingen op de arbeidsmarkt, wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving, risico's binnen de inhuurketen, tarieven, schaarste en de inrichting van inhuurtrajecten. Deze adviesfunctie is verweven met de uitvoering van de dienstverlening en vormt geen afzonderlijke opdracht.

title: Netherlands – Collection agency services – Inning Invordering Bezwaar en Beroep
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europeesopenbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Opdracht Een van de taken van de gemeente is handhaving op parkeren. De gemeente Breda voert deze handhaving in eigen beheer uit. Daarbij worden sinds 2019 scanauto’s ingezet. Hierbij worden naheffingsaanslagen uitgeschreven. Deze naheffingen dienen geïnd te worden. Deze uitvraag betreft de oplegging en inning/invordering van de door de gemeente uitgeschreven naheffingsaanslagen voor zowel Nederlandse als buitenlandse kentekens. Verder kan er bezwaar gemaakt worden tegen deze naheffingen. De afhandeling van deze bezwaarschriften en de afhandeling van eventuele daarop volgende beroepschriften vormen eveneens onderdeel van deze opdracht. Ter indicatie zijn hierbij de cijfers van 2024. Het betreft de volgende aantallen NHA’s: Nederlandse kentekens: 110.000 Belgische kentekens: 11.000 Duitse kentekens: 1.500 andere landen kentekens: 5.000 27.755 bezwaren per jaar 88 beroepszaken per jaar De indicatie van de verwachte aantallen is ontleend aan de huidige situatie. Benadrukt wordt dat de omvang een indicatie is waaraan geen rechten ontleend kunnen worden. De werkelijke omvang van de opdracht kan dus in positieve of negatieve zin afwijken van de genoemde indicatie. Een doelmatige periodieke rapportage van de uitgevoerde activiteiten behoort eveneens tot de scope. De gemeente verwacht van de te contracteren partij dat ingespeeld wordt op nieuwe ontwikkelingen en wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving. Deze partij communiceert bijvoorbeeld proactief wanneer invordering in meerdere/nieuwe landen mogelijk wordt. De te contracteren partij verstuurt de NHA’s, waarbij de vormgeving in samenwerking met de gemeente tot stand komt, o.a. dat op de uitgeschreven NHA’s verwezen naar de uitvoerende partij voor de bezwaarmogelijkheden, dit dient in tekst en d.m.v. een QR duidelijk te worden. De gemeente zorgt ervoor dat op haar website verwezen wordt naar de bezwaarmogelijkheden bij opdrachtnemer. De gemeente is op zoek naar een partij die een snelle en efficiënte afhandeling van de invorderingsdossiers en bezwarencases kan borgen, waarbij klantvriendelijkheid hoog in het vaandel staat. Wetende dat niemand ‘blij’ wordt van een naheffing, is juist bij de klantcontacten een klantvriendelijke en waar nodig de-escalerende benadering voor de gemeente van belang. De gemeente Breda is momenteel bezig met het opstellen van een wielklembeleid. Momenteel is de gemeente bezig met de eerste onderzoekende fase. Het is mogelijk dat tijdens het contract of net voor het vastleggen van het contract meer informatie beschikbaar is over het invoeren van het wielklembeleid. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen: Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de levering van deze diensten een raamovereenkomst te sluiten. De overeenkomst treedt in werking na ondertekening en heeft een looptijd van twee (2) jaar na het moment van livegang op 1 februari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze twee (2) maal met één (1) jaar te verlengen. De besluitvorming ten aanzien van deze verlenging(en) geschiedt op basis van evaluatie van de geleverde prestatie. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op € 995.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Netherlands – Liability insurance services – Aansprakelijkheidsverzekering en Goed werkgeverschapsverzekering(en)
description: Deze aanbestedingsleidraad omschrijft de Europese aanbesteding volgens de openbare procedure om te komen tot het afsluiten van een overeenkomst met Provincie Zeeland. De Provincie Zeeland heeft in 2021 een Europese aanbesteding uitgevoerd waarbij de Aansprakelijkheidsverzekering en Goed Werkgeverschapsverzekering in combinatie zijn aanbesteed. De polissen zijn ingegaan op 1 januari 2022 en lopen van rechtswege af op 1 januari 2027. De verzekeringen dienen daarom opnieuw te worden aanbesteed via een openbare Europese aanbesteding. Op deze Europese aanbesteding zijn de Richtlijn 2014/24/EU en de Aanbestedingswet 2012 van toepassing. Aansprakelijkheidsverzekering voor de Provincie Zeeland De Provincie Zeeland wenst een Aansprakelijkheidsverzekering specifiek voor de Provincie af te sluiten voor een periode van 3 jaar met een optie tot 3 maal een verlenging van 12 maanden. Goed Werkgeverschapsverzekering Provincie Zeeland wenst in combinatie met de Aansprakelijkheidsverzekering een zogenaamde Goed Werkgeverschapsverzekering - of gelijkwaardige producten - voor haar werknemers en inhuur af te sluiten voor eveneens een periode van 3 jaar met een optie tot 3 maal een verlenging van 12 maanden. Voor de Goed Werkgeverschapsverzekering mogen ook alternatieven worden aangeboden zoals een Schadeverzekering voor Werknemers tijdens werktijd en een 24-uurs Ongevallen-verzekering. Deelopdrachten 1 en 2 Genoemde verzekeringen worden in combinatie ingekocht. De Aansprakelijkheidsverzekering voor de Provincie betreft deelopdracht 1 en de Goed Werkgeverschapsverzekering betreft deelopdracht 2. Beide deelopdrachten zijn onlosmakelijk aan elkaar verbonden vanwege de premiestelling en de dekking. De deelopdrachten worden daarom aan één en dezelfde partij gegund aan de inschrijver met de Beste Prijs-Kwaliteitverhouding (PKV). De inschrijver dient zijn Inschrijving volledig te baseren op het gevraagde in deze Aanbestedingsleidraad inclusief de bijbehorende Bijlagen. Het indienen van een alternatieve aanbieding dat niet voldoet aan deze Aanbestedingsleidraad met bijbehorende Bijlagen, waaronder het Programma van Eisen, is niet toegestaan.

title: France – Electricity – Fourniture d'électricité produite en autoconsommation collective - Centrale d'achat-.
description: La Communauté d’agglomération d’Épinal s’est constituée en centrale d’achat pour offrir aux acheteurs soumis au Code de la Commande Publique, et ayant leur siège social sur le territoire de l’agglomération, un dispositif permettant de répondre aux objectifs de simplification de l’acte d’achat, de sécurisation juridique et d’optimisation des dépenses. Ainsi, la Centrale d’achat assure le rôle d’intermédiaire en application de l’article L.2113-2, 2° du code de la commande publique pour tout acheteur implanté sur le territoire de l’agglomération et assume, à cet effet, la responsabilité du déroulement des procédures et de leur légalité. La liste des adhérents prenant part à la présente consultation est jointe en annexe 1 de l’acte d’engagement du présent marché. Pour la réalisation de l’objet de ce marché : • la centrale d’achat, en qualité de coordonnatrice, est l’acheteur chargé de la préparation, la passation, la signature et la notification de ce marché et des éventuels avenants associés ; • chaque Adhérent Participant est chargé, quant à lui, d’exécuter le marché pour ce qui le concerne. Les Adhérents Participants ont décidé de s’impliquer dans une opération d’autoconsommation collective étendue au sens de l’article 1bis de l’arrêté du 21 novembre 2019 fixant le critère de proximité géographique de l'autoconsommation collective étendue répondant aux critères cumulatifs suivants : • l'un des producteurs ou des consommateurs participants est une commune ou un EPCI à fiscalité propre ; • l'ensemble des producteurs et des consommateurs participants sont des organismes publics ou privés exerçant une mission de service public ou des sociétés d'économie mixtes locales mentionnées à l'article L. 1522-1 du CGCT et leurs filiales ; • les points de soutirage et d'injection sont situés exclusivement dans le ressort géographique de l'établissement public de coopération intercommunale à fiscalité propre participant au projet ou auquel adhèrent la ou les communes participant au projet ; • par dérogation, la puissance cumulée des installations de production des projets répondants aux critères cumulatifs de cette dérogation est inférieure à 10MW. Le présent marché a pour objet l’approvisionnement en électricité d’origine renouvelable des points de livraison des Adhérents Participants , incluant les prestations ci-dessous : • l’approvisionnement non exclusif en électricité d’origine renouvelable des points de livraison des Adhérents Participants, • la gestion et la certification des garanties de capacité et des garanties d’origine associées à ces productions, • la mission de responsable d’équilibre associée aux injections d’électricité du ou des actifs de production conformément à l’article L. 321-15 du code de l’énergie ; • les conditions de l’injection, sur le réseau public de distribution exploité par le Gestionnaire du Réseau de Distribution (GRD) Enedis, d’électricité produite par le Producteur du ou des actifs de production. Le présent marché prend effet à compter de sa notification au Producteur Titulaire et jusqu’au 31 décembre 2037 inclus.

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss von nicht exklusiven Rabattverträgen gemäß § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zu Arzneimitteln (Open-House-Verfahren)
description: Das vorliegende Verfahren unterliegt nicht dem Vergaberecht. Es handelt sich um ein Open-House-Verfahren. Im Interesse der Transparenz und einer möglichst breit angelegten Information der interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmer erfolgt diese Bekanntmachung im Supplement zum Amtsblatt der Europäischen Union. Soweit im Rahmen dieser Bekanntmachung Formulierungen verwendet werden, welche auf die Vergabe eines öffentlichen Auftrags hindeuten, ist dies allein den Vorgaben dieses Bekanntmachungsformulars geschuldet. Hiermit sowie mit der Nutzung des Mediums "TED" ist keine Unterwerfung unter vergaberechtlichen Regelungen verbunden, deren Geltung kraft Gesetzes bzw. Vergabeordnungen und nach der Rechtsprechung des Europäischen Gerichtshofs nicht verpflichtend vorgegeben ist. Die AOK Baden-Württemberg (AOK) beabsichtigt, mit allen geeigneten pharmazeutischen Unternehmern nicht exklusive Rabattverträge gem. § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zu Arzneimitteln mit den in Anlage 3 zu den Teilnahmebedingungen sowie unter Ziffer 5.1 dieser Auftragsbekanntmachung und unter Ziffer 5.1 der Folgebekanntmachungen benannten Wirkstoffen zu schließen. Die Vertragslaufzeit beginnt frühestens am 1.7.2024, sie beträgt maximal 30 Monate und endet spätestens am 31.12.2026 (mit Ausnahme folgender Wirkstoffe/Wirkstoffkombinationen: Ustekinumab, Laufzeitende 31.12.2024; Beclometason dipropionat + Formoterolhemifumarat-1-Wasser + Glycopyrroniumbromid, Laufzeitende 31.3.2025; Somatropin, Laufzeitende 30.6.2026; Indacaterol maleat + Glycopyrronium bromid, Laufzeitende 30.6.2026; Tacrolimus-1-Wasser, Laufzeitende: 30.6.2026). Ein Vertragsschluss ist innerhalb des Zeitraums vom 1.7.2024 bis 31.12.2026 jederzeit zu einem Monatsersten möglich (mit Ausnahme der zuvor genannten Wirkstoffe/Wirkstoffkombinationen). Zu einer möglichen Erweiterung des Beschaffungsbedarfs durch die AOK, zu den Fristen und zum Vertragsbeginn siehe im Übrigen die Ziffer 5.1 dieser Bekanntmachung, Abschnitte A.I.4 und A.III.3 der Teilnahmebedingungen sowie Anlage 3 zu den Teilnahmebedingungen.

title: Belgium – Construction structures and materials; auxiliary products to construction (except electric apparatus) – CONCEPTION ET FABRICATION DE DEUX BATARDEAUX METALLIQUES POUR LES ECLUSES DE KAIN ET D’HERINNES (HAUT-ESCAUT)
description: Le présent marché a pour objet la conception et la fourniture de deux batardeaux d’une portée de 14 mètres destinés à permettre la mise à sec des écluses du Haut-Escaut, appartenant à la Région wallonne (sites de Kain et Hérinnes). Les ouvrages existants, construits dans les années 1920, sont dimensionnés pour accueillir un trafic fluvial de classe Va au maximum. Les deux écluses présentent une conception similaire, les batardeaux devront donc être compatibles avec les deux ouvrages. A titre informatif, leur conception est également similaire à celles des écluses de Berchem, Audenarde et Asper situées en Flandre. Les hauteurs d’eau de calcul à considérer pour le dimensionnement des structures métalliques sont également comparables entre les différents sites. Un batardeau pourra être constitué de plusieurs éléments distincts, assemblés entre eux au moyen de joints étanches. La hauteur totale d’un batardeau est fixée à 6 mètres. Les batardeaux devront être dimensionnés conformément aux réglementations en vigueur, et notamment aux Eurocodes. Une attention particulière sera portée au nombre de joints du batardeau, qui constituent autant de points faibles pour l’étanchéité, ainsi qu’au poids unitaire des éléments le composant, les sites étant difficilement accessibles pour des engins de levage de grande capacité. Le marché comprend notamment : La vérification de l’ensemble des dimensions in situ nécessaire à la réalisation des plans d’atelier ; La fourniture d’une note de calcul complète d’exécution comprenant une note concernant la manutention ; La fabrication des batardeaux en atelier ; Le transport des batardeaux vers leur site de stockage (situé à Kain, Hérinnes ou autre site SPW VH Tournai à définir). La fourniture d’une note de bonnes pratiques relative à la vie de l’ouvrage, comprenant notamment les prescriptions concernant le stockage, le remplacement des joints, la peinture anticorrosion ainsi que les consignes de sécurité lors des opérations de manutention ainsi que du dossier « As-built ». Le délai global d’exécution du marché est fixé à 240 jours calendrier et prend cours à la date fixée par l’ordre de service, conformément à l’article 116 du présent C.S.C.

title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – " Ausbildung und Gestaltung von seitlichen Baustellenzuwegungen im Längsverkehr auf BAB "
description: Im Zuge der Durchführung von Bauarbeiten müssen regelmäßig Baustellenfahrzeuge, Transportfahrzeuge und Baumaschinen in den Arbeitsbereich ein- und ausfahren. Hierfür kommen insbesondere bei langen Baustellenabschnitten Baustellenzuwegungen innerhalb der Arbeitsstelle, d. h. im Längsverkehr der Autobahn, zum Einsatz. Solche Zuwegungen führen zu zusätzlichen Konfliktpunkten mit dem fließenden Verkehr, die die Verkehrssicherheit mindern bzw. zu Störungen im Verkehrsablauf führen können. Aktuell gibt es keine Standards für die Ausbildung und Gestaltung von solchen Baustellenzuwegungen. Während Baustellenzuwegungen in Regelwerken und Arbeitsschutzvorschriften grundsätzlich berücksichtigt werden, liegen bislang nur wenige wissenschaftlich fundierte Erkenntnisse zu deren sicherer und leistungsfähiger Gestaltung vor. Ziel dieses Forschungsvorhabens ist die systematische Untersuchung von Baustellenzuwegungen innerhalb von Arbeitsstellen längerer Dauer auf BAB sowie die Erarbeitung wissenschaftlich fundierter Empfehlungen für deren Planung, Gestaltung und Betrieb. Weiterhin sollen geeignete Bewertungsmaßstäbe entwickelt werden, mit denen die Eignung unterschiedlicher Lösungen hinsichtlich Verkehrssicherheit, Verkehrsablauf und Praktikabilität beurteilt werden kann. Als Ergebnis des Forschungsvorhabens sind Handlungsempfehlungen für die Planung, Ausschreibung, Genehmigung und den Betrieb von Baustellenzuwegungen im Längsverkehr zu erarbeiten. Es sind unter anderem Vorgaben zur geeigneten Lage, Entwicklungslänge, Beschilderung und Markierung sowie zu verkehrstechnischen Maßnahmen abgeleitet werden. Zudem sollen Vorschläge für die Fortschreibung bestehender Regelwerke, Leitfäden, Verordnungen und technischer Vorschriften abgeleitet werden (z. B. RSA, VwV StVO, ZTV SA). Das Vorhaben soll einen Beitrag zur sicheren, effizienten und regelwerkskonformen Abwicklung von Arbeitsstellen längerer Dauer auf hochbelasteten Bundesautobahnen leisten.

Veřejná zakázka je rozdělena na následující části: A) MŠ Komerční 704/22a B) DPS Chalupova 1/1 C) ZŠ Bohumínská 1082/72 D) MŠ Bohumínská 450/68 E) KD Koněvova 151/107 F) JSDH Požární 114/26 (Heřmanice) G) Květinová síň (u správy hřbitova) H) MŠ Chrustova 1448/11 Hlavním předmětem celé nadlimitní veřejné zakázky jsou dodávky. Účastník zadávacího řízení je oprávněn podat nabídku v tomto zadávacím řízení bez ohledu na to, zda podal či podá nabídku v samostatných zadávacích řízeních na ostatní části této veřejné zakázky. Pokud není uvedeno jinak, rozumí se v zadávací dokumentaci veřejnou zakázkou část veřejné zakázky s názvem „Instalace OZE na budovách MOb Slezská Ostrava – část A – MŠ Komerční 704/22a“, která je zadávána v rámci nadlimitní veřejné zakázky rozdělené na části pod souhrným názvem „Instalace OZE na budovách Mob Slezská Ostrava“. Předmětem veřejné zakázky „Instalace OZE na budovách MOb Slezská Ostrava – část A – MŠ Komerční 704/22a“ je kompletní dodávka a realizace fotovoltaické elektrárny včetně servisu na objektu Mateřské školy Slezská Ostrava, Komerční 704/22a, Muglinov, 712 00 Ostrava. Fotovoltaická elektrárna bude tvořena 53 fotovoltaickými panely o jednotkovém výkonu 450 Wp a celkovém instalovaném výkonu 23,85 kWp. Součástí řešení bude bateriová akumulace o celkové kapacitě 27,6 kWh, tvořená dvěma bateriovými sestavami, každou o kapacitě 13,8 kWh. Součástí plnění bude zejména dodávka a montáž fotovoltaických panelů, nosných konstrukcí, střídačů, bateriových úložišť, rozvaděčů, napojení provedené přípravy kabeláže a kabelových tras, ochranných a jistících prvků, uzemnění přepěťových ochran, řídicích a monitorovacích prvků a dalšího souvisejícího technologického vybavení. Dílo bude provedeno jako kompletní, bezpečný, provozuschopný a funkční celek, v souladu s „Projektovou dokumentací k instalaci fotovoltaiky a akumulace na vybraném vzorku FVE - MŠ SLEZSKÁ OSTRAVA, Objekt Komerční 704/22a, 712 00 Ostrava – Muglinov“ (dále jen „projektová dokumentace“), a Technickou specifikací, které jsou přílohou smlouvy o dílo a zároveň jsou přílohou č. 10 a 11 zadávací dokumentace. Součástí plnění bude dále zajištění dlouhodobého, bezpečného, spolehlivého, hospodárného a technicky správného provozu Díla, které spočívá především v poskytování komplexních servisních služeb. Obsah servisních služeb je blíže popsán v návrhu smlouvy o poskytování služeb servisu, která je přílohou č. 3 zadávací dokumentace. Veškeré uvedené technické parametry je účastník povinen respektovat s výjimkou odkazů na určité dodavatele nebo výrobky, nebo patenty na vynálezy, užitné vzory, průmyslové vzory, ochranné známky nebo označení původu. V případě rozporu mezi Technickou specifikací a projektovou dokumentací má přednost požadavek zajišťující vyšší kvalitativní, bezpečnostní nebo funkční standard, není-li ve Smlouvě výslovně uvedeno jinak, přičemž co je případný vyšší kvalitativní, bezpečností nebo funkční standard posoudí technický dozor investora (TDI). Veřejná zakázka je realizována v rámci projektu s názvem „Instalace OZE na budovách MOb Slezská Ostrava I“ a je spolufinancována z programu Nové obnovitelné zdroje v energetice (RES+), financovaného z prostředků Modernizačního fondu, zajišťovaného Ministerstvem životního prostředí prostřednictvím Státního fondu životního prostředí České republiky (dále jen „fond“) na základě výzvy ModF – RES+ č.4/2025 k předkládání žádostí poskytnutí podpory. Dodavatel je povinen dodržovat veškerá pravidla a podmínky vyplývající z uvedeného dotačního programu pro předmět této části veřejné zakázky, tedy zejména podmínky výzvy ModF – RES+ č.4/2025, která je přílohou č. 13 zadávací dokumentace. Účastník zadávacího řízení prohlašuje, že se před podáním nabídky důkladně seznámil se všemi přílohami tvořícími nedílnou součást zadávací dokumentace, což stvrzuje podáním nabídky. title: Poland – Hardware – Wykonanie i dostawę tablic rejestracyjnych dla Starostwa Powiatowego w Wejherowie oraz odbiór, zniszczenie i zagospodarowanie wycofanych z użytku tablic rejestracyjnych
description: Przedmiotem zamówienia jest wykonanie i sukcesywna dostawa do Wydziału Komunikacji Starostwa Powiatowego w Wejherowie tablic rejestracyjnych wyszczególnionych w załączniku nr 2 do SWZ, spełniających odpowiednio wymagania określone: 1) w rozdziale 6 rozporządzenia Ministra Infrastruktury z dnia 8 listopada 2024 r. w sprawie rejestracji i oznaczania pojazdów, wymagań dla tablic rejestracyjnych oraz wzorów innych dokumentów związanych z rejestracją pojazdów oraz w załączniku nr 12 do tego rozporządzenia; 2) w przypadku profesjonalnych tablic rejestracyjnych wskazanych w załączniku nr 2 do specyfikacji – w rozporządzeniu Ministra Infrastruktury z dnia 12 marca 2019 r. w sprawie profesjonalnej rejestracji pojazdów, stosowanych oznaczeń oraz opłat związanych z profesjonalną rejestracją pojazdów, w szczególności zgodnie z załącznikiem nr 9 do tego rozporządzenia. Przedmiot zamówienia obejmuje również odbiór, zniszczenie i zagospodarowanie zgodnie z przepisami o odpadach wycofanych z użytku tablic rejestracyjnych przekazanych przez Zamawiającego, zgodnie z art. 74b ustawy z dnia 20 czerwca 1997 r. – Prawo o ruchu drogowym.
